description: This file defines API endpoints for a bookstore application using FastAPI. It includes in-memory data for books, data models for books, and route handlers for listing books with pagination and filtering, as well as retrieving individual book details.

classes.name: BookBase
classes.description: Data model representing the basic information of a book, shared in responses.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: Extended data model including detailed description of a book.

classes.name: BookListResponse
classes.description: Response model for paginated list of books.

methods.name: list_books
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list books with optional category filtering and pagination.

methods.name: get_book
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve detailed information of a specific book by ID.
